messages:
Mira CSD: FYI Peregrine Health (P-4512) onboarding spike — embeddings down 3x expected past 48h, might hit QBR budget alarm. Can we lock a guardrail + prep QBR talking points? :eyes:
Sam (AE): Ack. When did trial start and who's the main eng contact?
Mira CSD: Started 2026-03-02. Eng contact is @tyson_eng. Daily avg tokens went from ~12M to ~38M since 03/18. Billing alert already fired.
billing-bot: Automated alert: project P-4512 exceeded 80% of monthly embedding quota (threshold 80%). Alert time: 2026-03-19T14:02:11Z
Alex (FinOps): Oof. Suggest immediate soft cap at 90% + notify, and add a throttled webhook to AE for high-impact ops. Quick command:
```
/budget-sentinel create --account P-4512 --threshold 0.9 --action notify:cs-oncall,ae-team --hardcap:false
```
Jules (CS Ops): I can run a short enablement tomorrow (30m) to recommend batching + caching patterns that cut embed calls. Also capture their rationale for high embed churn.
Sam (AE): Please add me on the invite. I’ll prep a one-pager on "why embeddings spiking" for the QBR — likely vector refresh strategy.
Mira CSD: Action items: Jules to run enablement, Alex to set sentinel, Sam to prep QBR short deck + ask engineering for usage pattern. I'll open a feedback thread after enablement. :raised_hands:
Alex (FinOps): Set the sentinel and webhook now, pinged #cs-escalations. Also exported a quick forecast:
```
Projected monthly spend at current rate: $9.6k
Previous baseline: $3.2k
Delta: +200%
```
Mira CSD: Thanks. Can one of you grab any sample prompts/refresh intervals from tyson before the call? that'll help recommendations.
Sam (AE): Will ask Ty. If they insist on realtime refresh, we propose a limited SLA change in QBR — otherwise suggest cache TTL + partial refresh.
Jules (CS Ops): Noted. I'll also add a short post-call feedback form to capture whether recommendations were actionable.
Mira CSD: Perfect. Closing the loop — I'll put this on the QBR radar and update the account health score after enablement. :white_check_mark:
